description: Users across all offices are unable to reach any internal services. Slack is also unreachable. Started 5 minutes ago.

New joiner Alex needs access to the analytics BigQuery dataset for the pricing project.
Our invoice for August shows 320 licences but we only have 280 people. Please review.
Contact me at alice.smith@example.com or +44 20 7946 0958 to discuss the outage on 10.0.12.5.
